from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class IncomeTaxRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single income tax expense entry extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    tax_expense_item: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name as written in the document (e.g., '所得税费用')")
    tax_expense_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the tax expense for the period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period (e.g., '2024 Q1')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit used in the report (e.g., '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    income_tax_records: list[IncomeTaxRecord]
